pwf.task.band.name: Deadline colour
pwf.task.band.formula: Days left are the forecast deadline minus today, counted in the unit of the source, which is working days. Red when not above the red threshold, yellow when not above the yellow threshold, green when not above the green threshold; farther away is not yet in range. When the working calendar of a year is missing the deadline cannot be computed and no colour is guessed.

pwf.task.duration.name: Planned duration
pwf.task.duration.formula: The working days of the task as declared in the workflow template; a milestone has duration 0.
pwf.task.remaining.name: Remaining duration
pwf.task.remaining.formula: Taken in this order: the days the doer entered by hand, else computed from the percent complete rounded up, else the days elapsed since the actual start.
pwf.task.percent.name: Percent complete
pwf.task.percent.formula: Entered by the doer; used only to compute the remaining duration, never to judge completion.
pwf.task.float.name: Total float
pwf.task.float.formula: The latest finish minus the earliest finish, in working days. A task is critical when its float is not above the critical threshold; negative means the schedule is past its deadline.
pwf.task.freeFloat.name: Free float
pwf.task.freeFloat.formula: The working days the task can slip without delaying a task that follows it, the smallest over its links and never above the total float.
pwf.task.variance.name: Finish variance against the baseline
pwf.task.variance.formula: The current finish minus the finish of the first baseline, in working days; positive is late. Rescheduling does not change the baseline.
pwf.task.returns.name: Times returned
pwf.task.returns.formula: Each time the approver returns the task this number goes up by one.
pwf.task.reschedules.name: Times rescheduled
pwf.task.reschedules.formula: The approved reschedule proposals that changed the deadline of the task, not counting approved external delays.

pwf.task.kpi.source.text: Source facts of the task, hash {hash}
pwf.task.kpi.formula.daysDeviation: The days between the deadline of the first baseline and the actual finish; an open overdue task takes today. Positive is late; the days exempted by approved pauses and external delays are taken off.
pwf.task.kpi.formula.onTimeRate: The share of tasks finished within the first-baseline deadline plus the grace days; an exempted task leaves both the numerator and the denominator.
pwf.task.kpi.formula.amountVariance: (Actual amount minus estimate) divided by the estimate, times 100. An estimate of 0 makes it not applicable.
pwf.task.kpi.formula.returnCount: The number of times the approver returned the task.
pwf.task.kpi.formula.evidenceCompletenes: The required evidence present divided by the required evidence, times 100.
pwf.task.kpi.formula.rescheduleCount: The approved reschedule proposals of the task, not counting approved external delays.
